messages:
morgan: quick UI question — should invoice line items be 'compact' by default for org views? current rows are roomy but for large ledgers it's a lot of scrolling. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-invoice-rows

ravi: compact improves scan speed but make sure touch targets stay >=44px. mobile is the main concern.

sana: accessible density rules: 1) touch targets >=44px, 2) focus rings preserved, 3) readable typography at 12px min. if compact removes context, add an expansion affordance.

keith: engineering note: we can support density classes (.row--compact / .row--comfortable). virtualization + variable row height adds complexity. prefer fixed heights per density to keep virtualizer simple.

anya: UX thought: default to 'comfortable' for new users and remember last choice with localStorage for returning users. power users can opt-in to 'compact'. show a small toggle: "Density: Comfortable / Compact" near table header.

designbot: uploaded two comps: https://assets.redwood/compact-rows-v1.png and comfortable-v1.png (compact reduces padding, hides subtle dividers).

product-bot: analytics note: org-ledgers with >250 rows have a 62% bounce rate on billing page. compact default for large orgs could reduce scroll and improve engagement. metric: BI/INV/engagement

morgan: proposal: responsive default: if rows > 100 then default to compact, else comfortable. explicit user toggle to override. persist per-user. ensure mobile always uses comfortable unless user explicitly picks compact.

sana: agree with mobile default to comfortable. also ensure the toggle has aria-pressed state and descriptive label like "Toggle compact density". announce change via polite aria-live: "Density set to compact".

keith: i'll implement density classes and localStorage persistence. plan: add CSS vars for --row-height-compact and --row-height-comfy so design tokens control spacing. PR ETA: 3 days.

anya: i'll update the UX spec and add the toggle copy: "Density: Comfortable | Compact — remember my preference". also add tooltip: "Compact reduces row padding to show more items."

morgan: action items: morgan -> update spec + figma; keith -> impl classes + persistence + aria-live; sana -> a11y review once PR up; anya -> add copy and tooltip; designbot -> push final comps. will gate behind FF `invoice_density_v1`.
